title: Local inessentiality of a singular infinitesimal automorphism of a real smooth parabolic geometry is equivalent to its singularity holonomy being P-conjugate into the grading-scale kernel
author: Jesse Alt
work: Essential Parabolic Structures and Their Infinitesimal Automorphisms
source_version: Official SIGMA 7 (2011) article 039, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2011.039; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

difficulty_reason: A singularity cannot be handled by ordinary flow-box coordinates. The author compares Weyl and adjoint tractor connections, uses nondegeneracy of the graded Killing form to identify the holonomy obstruction, and constructs an invariant exact Weyl structure using Cartan exponential coordinates. Closing the equivalence requires a scale-kernel reduction and an explicit tangent-flow argument on the reduced principal bundle.

proof_review.note: Read the exact Theorem1.2 statement, scale representation and exact Weyl-structure definitions, complete Lemma2.1, curvature/deformation identity background, full Propositions4.3/4.4 and both Section4.3 directions through physical page16. Necessity compares graded tractor-connection components and uses the Killing form to remove positive-degree terms; sufficiency constructs an exponential Weyl section, proves holonomy equivariance, and restricts its invariant scale reduction. Prior Cap-Slovak Weyl-connection correspondence is published background. The choice E_lambda=the grading element is explicitly offered in Section2.1 and matches the coefficients j in the authored Section4.3 calculation; select the real smooth category with this choice. No rank-one global Ferrand-Obata corollary or supporting Weyl lemma counted. Original selected statement/core pages rendered and visually inspected; exact header and native ZIP members verified. Editorial scope and warnings are retained.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Theorem1.2 in the real smooth category with the scale character lambda:G0 to positive real numbers defined by lambda prime(A)=B(E,A), E the grading element as explicitly permitted in Section2.1. For a parabolic geometry of type(G,P) and an infinitesimal automorphism X with a zero x0, there is a neighborhood carrying an X-preserved exact Weyl scale iff its singularity holonomy one-parameter subgroup in P is P-conjugate into Ker(lambda) inside G0.
